units.source: Anchors

This feature used to be called __TRILIUM_PH_0__Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (as it is the official name in the editor we are using), but in order not to collide with the concept of __TRILIUM_PH_2__Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_3__, we have renamed it to __TRILIUM_PH_4__Anchors.__TRILIUM_PH_5__
Anchors allows creating __TRILIUM_PH_0__links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to a certain part of a note, such as referencing a particular heading or section within a note.
This feature was introduced in TriliumNext v0.94.0 and augmented in v0.103.0 to support linking across notes.
Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
To create an anchor:
Place the cursor at the desired position where to place the anchor.
Look for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__, and then press the __TRILIUM_PH_3__ button.
Alternatively, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and look for __TRILIUM_PH_2__anchor__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
To place a link to an anchor in the same note:
Place the cursor at the desired position of the link, or select the text to turn into a link.

Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__K__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_6__, then select __TRILIUM_PH_7__Heading / anchor__TRILIUM_PH_8__ at the top of the __TRILIUM_PH_9____TRILIUM_PH_10__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_11__ dialog__TRILIUM_PH_12__. Alternatively, choose __TRILIUM_PH_13__Link to a heading or anchor__TRILIUM_PH_14__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_15__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_16__, which opens the dialog on that page.
Under __TRILIUM_PH_0__Anchors__TRILIUM_PH_1__, click the desired anchor to check it. Optionally, type a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_3__; without one, the link shows the anchor's name.
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to confirm.

Clicking a link to an anchor of the same note scrolls to the anchor and briefly highlights the block that holds it, in read-only notes and on shared pages. While editing, clicking the link shows its popup, whose __TRILIUM_PH_0__Jump to anchor__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button does the same, as do __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+click and double-click.

To change a link to an anchor, place the cursor inside it and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__K__TRILIUM_PH_3__. Since v0.107.0, the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_5__ dialog opens on __TRILIUM_PH_6__Heading / anchor__TRILIUM_PH_7__, with the linked anchor checked.

To link to a heading of the same note, no anchor is needed: pick the heading under __TRILIUM_PH_0__Headings__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the same dialog. See __TRILIUM_PH_2__Linking to a heading__TRILIUM_PH_3__ for details.
Linking across notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Trilium v0.103.0 introduces cross-note Anchors, which makes it possible to create __TRILIUM_PH_0__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ which point to a specific anchor in that document.
Compatibility with documents from previous versions__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Compatibility with documents from previous versions

units.source: For notes created prior to Trilium v0.103.0, you might notice that the Anchors might not be identified. This limitation is intentional in order not to have to re-process all the notes, looking for anchors.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Compatibility with documents from previous versions

units.source: To fix this, simply go that note and make any change (e.g. inserting a space), this will trigger the recalculation of the links.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Compatibility with documents from previous versions

units.source: Linking to anchors through the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog__TRILIUM_PH_2__
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: Create an anchor in the target note using the same process as described above.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: In another note, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__L__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to insert an internal link. Select the target note containing Anchors.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: If the target note contains Anchors, a section will appear underneath the note selector with the list of Anchors.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: Add the link normally.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: Clicking on a reference link pointing to an anchor will automatically scroll to the desired section.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

units.source: Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

units.source: Create an anchor in the target note using the same process as described above.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

units.source: Click on the anchor to reveal the anchor's floating toolbar.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

units.source: Click on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Copy anchor reference link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

units.source: Go to the note where to insert the link and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

units.source: Use this method only to insert __TRILIUM_PH_0__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ between two documents. To link to an anchor on the same note, use the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ dialog (__TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__K__TRILIUM_PH_7__) and select __TRILIUM_PH_8__Heading / anchor__TRILIUM_PH_9__ at its top instead.
units.context: Anchors > Linking across notes > Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar
